additional_local_changes: Freeze human notes once per stream and validate unmatched UTF8/size/path collisions
Sticky core/API/demo feedback identity; actual-use reporting distinct from enabled flag
Reject stale task/source/base/channel identity with fresh-root remediation
Prevent legacy unstamped grades from surviving a failed rejudge; validate finite weighted counts
Effective timeout and harvest path cache binding; reserved-script restoration during retry
Isolated local installer, offline launcher, pinned PR provenance and local release packaging
Invalidate requested selections before rerun output mutation so failed reruns cannot retain old grades; preserve unrequested modes
Exclude only the current task own prior lesson when checking direct API resume; restore verified lesson on skip
Bind authoring prompt templates and shared context instructions to each mode execution namespace; reject changed or legacy editor identity
